generic_rule: Every authority-reference mapping must have a bounded owning-source applicability/freshness proof route. A reference or canonical hash is not current applicability. acquisition_boundary.expand_source_set: Only separately provided exact source locators/identities explicitly accepted under the same bounded scope may extend this manifest in a future authorized attempt. No recursive repository/store discovery, guessed paths or live service calls.
acquisition_boundary.first_attempt: Read the named source/target/contract evidence and test whether it can establish each current proposition; source availability is a prerequisite to attempting acquisition, not proof that the acquisition will pass.
acquisition_boundary.already_known_gaps: Known missing proofs are not reset or resolved. This is a new targeted receiving/validation action, not a rerun of historical semantic inventory.

outcomes.PASS: Every required proposition independently verified (or inapplicability of a check proved by governing rule) for exact subject/source. Emit hash-bound evidence matrix and proof receipt. Enable one new REEVAL-BUDGET attempt overlay; do not mark prior attempt PASS or execute mapping.
outcomes.FAIL: Evidence proves a named incompatibility/staleness/invalid identity; record exact failed proposition and evidence. No reentry PASS.
outcomes.BLOCKED: Required concrete facts/rule inputs absent: retain named external gate and stop. No missing input invented.
outcomes.EXTERNAL_GATE_REQUIRED: Existing evidence is outside permitted/retrievable corpus: record exact required producer/locator/evidence and stop, with no acquisition effect.
outcomes.AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Technical facts complete but existing scope/phase rule does not authorize applicability. Record separate bounded decision-input requirement; no implied grant or ready decision.

technical_vs_authority: Technical compatibility does not grant normative applicability. Existing governing rule may establish it deterministically only with exact evidence. Otherwise complete facts -> bounded dossier -> independent readiness -> explicit Architect applicability decision -> accepted record -> REEVAL-BUDGET. No ready decision or grant is created now.
new_authority: NEW_AUTHORITY is a separate conditional branch only if a qualified existing authority cannot govern and an external owner determines replacement/renewal is required. Never silently renew, widen, republish or change this authority; stop for separately scoped work. Not currently proven necessary.

external_gate.required: Missing rows of the exact proof matrix with authenticated producer, source bytes/identity, target applicability and current snapshot/rule evidence.

reentry.condition: Accepted full PASS proof, source identities still valid and exact target unchanged; remove only REEVAL-BUDGET-CURRENT-APPLICABILITY in current attempt overlay.
reentry.history: Append new attempt evidence; original REEVAL-BUDGET BLOCKED result is immutable.
reentry.partial_or_negative: No reentry enablement; retain exact hold.
reentry.root_slot_rule: Acquisition PASS and reevaluation PASS do not themselves resolve root:budget or budget_policy slot; original final mapping criteria remain.

generalization.rule: AUTHORITY_REFERENCE does not imply CURRENT_APPLICABILITY / FRESHNESS
generalization.scope: Only record common planning requirement. No new actions, repairs, proofs or applicability decisions for other fields.
